summary: Tested new LIVE trading endpoints and LiveTradingPanel UI. All 8 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend LiveTradingPanel renders correctly with all required elements (header, BLOCKED+Jito OFF badges, reason banner mentioning all 3 env vars, 4 stat tiles, empty-state message). Simulation divider + 4 sim stat cards render below with real /api/stats data. No console/JS errors. Frontend now compiles successfully — the previous BACKEND_URL / FlashLoanDashboard ESLint warnings are no longer emitted in the latest webpack compile.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 972 lines — should be split into routers (live/, meme/, arbitrage/) for maintainability.

test_swap uses hardcoded SOL_USD_ESTIMATE=150.0 for base-unit conversion; should fetch a lightweight oracle price to avoid dangerously wrong sizing when SOL is far from $150 (safety-critical since amount_base is submitted to Jupiter).

/api/live/summary today-aggregation compares created_at (ISO string with 'T…') against today (YYYY-MM-DD). Lexical $gte works because ISO dates sort correctly, but a datetime range ($gte start-of-day, $lt next-day) is safer and more explicit.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing simulation-bot data already in Mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend live/* endpoints all behave correctly in default (safe) env: ready=false, simulation_mode=true, test_swap refuses even with dry_run=false. LiveTradingPanel visually verified. If SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY / LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED are ever set in this sandbox for retest, expect DNS-blocked errors when Jupiter/QuickNode/Jito are hit — that is env limitation, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. Both verification items from the request pass: (1) latest webpack compile prints 'Compiled successfully!' with zero react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings (previous BACKEND_URL warnings in Dashboard.js and FlashLoanDashboard.js are gone). (2) LiveTradingPanel + backend live-trading endpoints work correctly and the safety gate blocks all trades — including dry_run=false — while the trader is not fully configured.
